## Citation

Authors. Title. Venue. Year. DOI / arXiv.

## One-sentence summary

State the central contribution without copying the abstract.

## Problem

What problem are the authors trying to solve?

## Core idea

What makes the method work?

## Key results

Which results materially support the paper's claims?

## Limitations

What assumptions, missing controls, scope limits, or unresolved questions matter?

## What I learned

Record your own interpretation and connections to your research.

## Questions

- What would falsify the core claim?
- What experiment would be most informative next?
- Which assumptions are most fragile?
